description: Same data as rental_status (which takes the access code instead): rental state, start and end times, and delivered TH reported by the rigs. awaitingPoolApproval=true while a custom pool waits for manual approval (up to 2 hours, refunded if not approved); rejectedReason names why a pool was refused (refund queued). Needs rental_id and creator_secret. Not read-only: while unpaid it re-checks the payment, which can start the rental or queue a refund, and it re-sends a stalled pool switch.

creator_secret.description: creatorSecret from create_rental. Shown once; keep it private.

name: get_rental_status
